header: What every Vertex Supply seat includes

items.title: Unlimited work orders
items.description_text: No fee per job, whether a technician logs three calls a day or eleven.

items.title: Offline mobile app
items.description_text: Jobs, forms, photos and asset history are stored on the device, on iOS and Android.

items.title: Asset register with QR labels
items.description_text: Printed labels open a unit's full service record with one scan on site.

items.title: Accounting export
items.description_text: Transfers to DATEV, BMD and Sage 50, weekly or when a job closes, with parts and hours listed separately.

items.title: Support in German and English
items.description_text: Answers within two business hours, 07:00 to 19:00 CET, Monday to Friday.

items.title: Data hosted in the EU
items.description_text: Data centres in Frankfurt and Vienna, replicated between both. ISO 27001 certified since 2023.
